description: This file contains extension methods for the string class to support code generation tasks, such as converting strings to syntax expressions, identifiers, and escaping identifiers, within the Orleans code generation project.

classes.name: StringExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the string class to facilitate code generation in the Orleans project.

methods.name: GetLiteralExpression
methods.description: Converts a string into a Roslyn LiteralExpressionSyntax representing a string literal.

methods.name: ToIdentifier
methods.description: Converts a string to a SyntaxToken suitable for use as an identifier, handling C# keywords.

methods.name: EscapeIdentifier
methods.description: Escapes a string to be a valid C# identifier, prefixing with '@' if it is a C# keyword.

methods.name: ToIdentifierName
methods.description: Converts a string to an IdentifierNameSyntax, using ToIdentifier for handling keywords.
